summary: This is a retro-brutalist hackathon landing page for 'Banana Hacks' designed to drive participant registrations and spotlight event details, sponsors, and key perks.

stack.name: React + Vite
stack.why: Provides a fast and modern frontend development setup suited for component-driven UI construction.

stack.name: Tailwind CSS
stack.why: Facilitates building custom neo-brutalist borders, hard drop-shadows, and grid backgrounds with utility classes.

stack.name: Lucide React
stack.why: Offers a lightweight set of icons suitable for the bottom dock and status badges.

components.name: TopNavbar
components.purpose: Displays event branding, help link, location badge, dates, and dynamic clock display.

components.name: BadgeGroup
components.purpose: Renders segmented retro pill badges with borders and solid fills.

components.name: HeroSection
components.purpose: Presents primary headline with yellow highlighter accent, descriptive copy, live status pill, and CTA buttons.

components.name: SponsorStrip
components.purpose: Shows the 'BACKED BY' label followed by monospace sponsor brand names.

components.name: CharacterCard
components.purpose: Houses the interactive/animated character graphic, workshop tags, prize pill, and country counter in a framed panel.

components.name: DockToolbar
components.purpose: Presents a bottom floating neo-brutalist icon bar for quick utility navigation.

steps.title: Initialize project and theme configuration
steps.detail: Create a React Vite project and configure Tailwind CSS. Set custom colors including background `#fff6d7`, primary yellow `#fcd831`, dark border/text `#1a1a15`, and define an overlay grid background pattern.

steps.title: Implement retro grid layout structure
steps.detail: Build the main page wrapper with a full-height grid background, top fixed or sticky header, a 2-column main split layout for hero content and character card, and a fixed bottom dock anchor.

steps.title: Construct TopNavbar and status badges
steps.detail: Build `TopNavbar.jsx` with left-aligned 'Banana Hacks' and 'HELP' link, and right-aligned segmented boxes showing 'WORLDWIDE • OCT 9-12' and live updating time like '11:52 AM'.

steps.title: Assemble HeroSection content and call-to-actions
steps.detail: Render `HeroSection.jsx` featuring the segmented badge ('OCT 9-12, 2026', 'INTERNATIONAL • FREE', '789 REGISTERED'), the heavy title 'Build something worth showing off.' with yellow background highlight, green 'Hacking is live right now' pulsating badge, and twin CTAs with hard drop-shadow borders.

steps.title: Build CharacterCard panel and floating badges
steps.detail: Create `CharacterCard.jsx` with a solid 2px black border, top-left registered badge, right-hand workshop tag, center mascot illustration, and bottom orange prize banner ('$500 IN PRIZES, LICENSES & DOMAINS').

steps.title: Add SponsorStrip and Bottom Navigation Dock
steps.detail: Render the bottom sponsor list under the hero section and build `DockToolbar.jsx` as a rounded floating container with partitioned black-bordered icon buttons, including a yellow-highlighted active bookmark icon.

steps.title: Audit responsive breakpoints and interactive states
steps.detail: Ensure the layout collapses gracefully to a single-column stack on screens under 1024px width, verifying touch target sizes, active button push states (translate-x/y with reduced shadow), and dock scrolling.
